name: learnsdlc
description: LearnSDLC: experiential, AI-integrated software development training for adult learners

scripts.build: npm run build -w @learnsdlc/shared && npm run build -w @learnsdlc/api && npm run build -w @learnsdlc/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @learnsdlc/shared && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:dev -w @learnsdlc/api" "npm run dev -w @learnsdlc/web"
scripts.start: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:prod -w @learnsdlc/api" "npm run start -w @learnsdlc/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @learnsdlc/api && npm run test:web && npm run test:runner
scripts.test:scripts: npm run build -w @learnsdlc/shared && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs scripts/seed-class/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @learnsdlc/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.stress: node scripts/stress/sandbox.mjs && node scripts/stress/lambda.mjs && node scripts/stress/api.mjs

//overrides.qs: Lifts the qs that express, body-parser and superagent accept (^6.14 and up) to the patched release the audit gate requires.
//overrides.shell-quote: concurrently pins shell-quote exactly at 1.9.0, a release the audit flags; this lifts it to the patched 1.12 minor.
//overrides.@nestjs/platform-express: Lifts the multer that @nestjs/platform-express pins exactly (2.2.0) to the patched 2.5 release; "." keeps the package itself on the range apps/api asks for.
//overrides.react: Holds every copy in the tree on the React apps/web depends on.
//overrides.react-dom: Holds every copy in the tree on the React DOM apps/web depends on.
//overrides.@types/react: Holds every copy in the tree on the React types apps/web depends on.
//overrides.@types/react-dom: Holds every copy in the tree on the React DOM types apps/web depends on.
//overrides.@nestjs/common: Holds every copy in the tree on the Nest version apps/api depends on.
//overrides.handlebars: ts-jest accepts handlebars 4.7.9, which the audit flags as critical; this lifts it to the patched 4.7.10.
